evidence_for_same_work: identical Latin title 'Mappa Geographica exhibens Electoratum Brandenborgensem sive Marchiam Veterem, Mediam et Novam nec non Marchiam Ukeram', identical fonds (AKS) and identical catalogue context node, both dated 1758
why_not_resolved: the impression relation (same copy / same plate different impression / different plate / reproduction) can only be settled by comparing the sheets, and AKS 1132 A has no digitisation. No pixel or visual comparison was therefore possible.
counting_rule: two catalogue records of the same work are ONE source until the impression relation is established; MAPGEN-019 counts one
other_copies_of_the_same_work_seen_in_dd: 1220 LGB K 422 A (1267037), 1758-2012, explicitly '(Nachdruck)' - a modern reprint held in a different BLHA collection; plus DDB items 4CS52Y47I5JCLFPCHFQMJV7TNXDMFTSO and O6SYDMEEFF3RJ6AVISJ7TVATDLOG2Z4I. The '(Nachdruck)' note belongs to 1220 LGB K 422 A and NOT to AKS 1145 A.
